title: Grounding Language Models in Speech Does Not Fix AI Flavor: Calibrated LLM Judges, Goodhart Traps, and a Preference-Tuning Fix

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 Sections 3--5, Appendix A/B/C and Zenodo v0.1; https://arxiv.org/html/2611.19840v1
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 0.6B multi-round CPT/DPO/SFT, speech/TTS/prosody interventions, repeated model-judge labels and human calibration/reference material.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: The full training/annotation campaign is outside a short local/single-device budget. No paid judge calls or model weights downloaded; only 393KB code archive inspected.
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验高成本不复现，审查DONE；只实现evaluator专用catch门槛、双judge换序一致性、分歧tie和ID隔离CPU协议，不生成LLM verdict。

summary: 三项语音接地干预为负结果，RA-Eval先用catch trials校准judge再双隔离换序标注，并检查DPO的长度偏差转导。本地只加工外部verdict，缺项/分歧/不合格均tie，不将fixture协议1分当模型能力。
